## PR #660 严格审计补充：订单空间外置后的激活事务会破坏旧订单并泄漏新载荷

### 1. 概述

当前 HEAD `b3b6d317` 上，#680 将长路径外置后出现 P1 正确性回归。新订单尚未证明能写入黑板时，旧活动订单已经取消并释放、队列可能已清空；写第 17 个点失败后，旧订单不可恢复，新订单未激活，前 16 个点残留，外置载荷未释放。缺黑板组件时还会静默跳过写入并返回 `Activated`。本项是合并阻断。

### 2. 结构

订单激活必须是单一事务：先验证并预留新订单的载荷、黑板和结果容量；确认全部可提交后，再取消旧订单并一次写入新黑板和活动订单。失败时旧订单与队列保持原样，新载荷立即释放，并产生 #650 的可查询 admission 结果。

### 3. 详情

- 替换路径先终结旧订单并可清空队列，之后才激活新订单：[OrderSubmitter.cs#L82-L103](https://github.com/MightyBubble/Ludots/blob/b3b6d31770352afee8ea20efcd71571bbd724412/src/Core/Gameplay/GAS/Orders/OrderSubmitter.cs#L82-L103)。
- 激活先写黑板，完成后才设置 Active：[OrderSubmitter.cs#L151-L162](https://github.com/MightyBubble/Ludots/blob/b3b6d31770352afee8ea20efcd71571bbd724412/src/Core/Gameplay/GAS/Orders/OrderSubmitter.cs#L151-L162)。
- 外置路径接受最多 64 点，黑板每键只有 16 点：[OrderSpatialPayloadOps.cs#L17-L25](https://github.com/MightyBubble/Ludots/blob/b3b6d31770352afee8ea20efcd71571bbd724412/src/Core/Gameplay/GAS/Orders/OrderSpatialPayloadOps.cs#L17-L25)、[BlackboardSpatialBuffer.cs#L10-L17](https://github.com/MightyBubble/Ludots/blob/b3b6d31770352afee8ea20efcd71571bbd724412/src/Core/Gameplay/GAS/Components/BlackboardSpatialBuffer.cs#L10-L17)。
- 第 17 点才抛错，此前点已逐个写入：[OrderSubmitter.cs#L182-L212](https://github.com/MightyBubble/Ludots/blob/b3b6d31770352afee8ea20efcd71571bbd724412/src/Core/Gameplay/GAS/Orders/OrderSubmitter.cs#L182-L212)。
- 异常路径没有事务性释放新载荷：[OrderSpatialPayloadOps.cs#L60-L90](https://github.com/MightyBubble/Ludots/blob/b3b6d31770352afee8ea20efcd71571bbd724412/src/Core/Gameplay/GAS/Orders/OrderSpatialPayloadOps.cs#L60-L90)。
- 对缺少 Spatial/Entity/Int 黑板组件只做 `world.Has` 后跳过，调用方仍返回 `Activated`。

### 4. 场景

角色已有活动/排队订单，新订单携带 17 至 64 个路径点；或模板漏装任一订单黑板组件。

### 5. 边界

- 不把长路径容量降回 16 来掩盖事务错误。
- 不捕获异常后继续返回 Activated。
- 旧状态在提交前不得破坏；不靠失败后重建旧订单补偿。
- 结果复用 #650；批量容量合同仍由 #570 承担。

### 6. UAT

```gherkin
功能: 新订单激活失败时旧订单和载荷保持一致

场景: 玩家用十七个路径点的新命令打断正在执行的订单
  假如黑板每个键只能保存十六个点
  当系统尝试接收新命令
  那么新命令在取消旧订单前被明确拒绝
  并且旧订单和原队列保持原样
  并且黑板没有残留新路径点
  并且新载荷槽已经释放

场景: 角色缺少新订单要求的黑板组件
  当系统尝试激活新订单
  那么系统在改变旧订单前明确失败并指出缺失组件
  并且不会报告为 Activated
```

结论：当前 HEAD 未解决；#680 必须保持 OPEN，PR #660 不得兑现 `Closes #680`。

> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

PR #660 final audit at `df45bb8d54dfa419f33cde503d01dbcc75803c49` confirms #680 order replacement is transactional.

Root cause: replacement could cancel the old active order and release/clear queue state before the new payload, blackboard entries, and result capacity were proven writable. Failures on 17-64 point paths or missing blackboard components could leave partial target data, leak the new payload, and still report activation.

Fix boundary: submission prepares the new payload and complete blackboard copy first, validates all authored components and capacities, and reserves the admission/terminal result before touching the old order. Only a successful commit cancels the prior order. Failure preserves the old active order and queue, leaves no partial blackboard writes, releases the new payload, and never returns `Activated`.

Evidence on merge ref `2faeb815f`: `InputOrderAbilityAuditTests` 74/74, `SuperweaponContextShowcaseAcceptanceTests` 3/3, and architecture guards 47/47 passed, including 17-64 point and missing-component boundaries. Full HEAD GasTests have zero HEAD-only failures versus main; both PR checks pass; build has 0 errors; `git diff --check` passes.

Issue remains OPEN pending maintainer close policy; no capacity reduction or fallback was used.
